extracted.intended_audience: authors preparing and submitting manuscripts to the Nagoya Mathematical Journal (mathematicians)
extracted.subtask_description: Author submission and publication instructions for Nagoya Mathematical Journal, describing scope, accepted article types, submission procedures, and open‑access/APC guidance. Targeted to researchers preparing manuscripts for this specific journal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and expected quality of submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Nagoya Mathematical Journal "endeavoured to publish original research papers of the highest quality and of general interest, covering a broad range of pure mathematics."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit work that is original research, of high scholarly quality, of general interest to the pure mathematics community, and appropriate to the broad scope of the journal. The journal is published quarterly and aims to support mathematics worldwide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted article types / research‑article classification
rubrics_metrics.description: "We accept the following types of articles: Article*" and "For the purposes of Gold Open Access funding, this journal considers these article types to be research articles."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should ensure their manuscript fits one of the journal's accepted article types. Note that certain article types are classified as research articles for Gold Open Access funding; check the journal's detailed list to determine classification and eligibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access / APC eligibility and waivers
rubrics_metrics.description: Certain article types (for example, Articles and Reviews) "may be eligible for APC waivers or discounts under one of the agreements Cambridge University Press has made to support open access."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the journal's open access options and the publisher's agreements to determine whether your article is eligible for APC discounts or waivers. For authors not covered by an agreement and without APC funding, follow the journal's instructions on how to request an APC waiver.

rubrics_metrics.name: APC requirements for specific article types
rubrics_metrics.description: "** No APCs are required for these article types."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verify which specific article types carry no APCs. Do not assume Gold OA applies uniformly—check the journal's detailed notes on which article types require payment and which do not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of the partner submission system (account required)
rubrics_metrics.description: "You will need an account for the submission system, which is separate to your Cambridge Core account."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create and use the journal's partner submission-system account to submit manuscripts. For login and submission support, visit the submission and support pages linked by the publisher. Allow time to set up the separate account before submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review author instructions and preparing materials before submission
rubrics_metrics.description: "Please review this journal's author instructions, particularly the preparing your materials page, before submitting your manuscript."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Thoroughly read the journal's author instructions and the 'preparing your materials' guidance to comply with formatting, metadata, file, and other submission requirements prior to uploading to the submission system. Failure to follow these preparatory instructions may impede submission or consideration.
